rules: Materialization alone is not a membership event and cannot change total_count.
Every materialized character_id may occur in only one mutually-exclusive population group at a time within the registry.
Temporary absence is a presence overlay and cannot exceed group total_count.
Moving between Academy population groups requires an explicit transition event preserving identity/history.
Population reconciliation must fail closed if counts and persistent identities disagree.
For generated cadets, materialized_slot_bindings permanently maps population_slot_ref to character_id.
A population_slot_ref may be materialized at most once.
